title.en: Atlantis port fuel depot blast injures six
title.zh: 亚特兰蒂斯港储油罐爆炸致 6 人受伤

overview.en: Six people were injured in an explosion at a fuel depot near Atlantis port, officials said.
overview.zh: 据官员称，亚特兰蒂斯港附近一座储油设施发生爆炸，6 人受伤。

common.en: Six people were injured in an explosion at a fuel/storage depot near Atlantis port.
common.zh: 亚特兰蒂斯港附近一座储油设施发生爆炸，6 人受伤。

items.en: The cause is under investigation, officials said.
items.zh: 官员称事故原因正在调查中。

items.en: No deaths were reported, emergency services said.
items.zh: 应急部门称无死亡报告。
